card: Backports documentation updates to the 29.x maintenance branch. It adds entries for BIP 433 (Pay to Anchor) and BIP 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to bips.md and updates the v29.x release notes. These changes backport PRs already merged on master (#34252 and #36377).
evidence: PR description references backports of master PRs #34252 and #36377
problem: The 29.x maintenance branch is missing documentation entries in bips.md for BIP 433 and BIP 461, both of which were already merged into master, along with release notes tracking the branch.

risk.why: Only documentation files are changed, carrying no runtime or consensus risk.

scope_notes: The PR contains only three documentation commits (+8/-0 in 2 files); the raw merge-base diff contains hundreds of unrelated files due to branch divergence between the 29.x branch and master.
summary: Backports two documentation PRs to the 29.x maintenance branch and updates the 29.x release notes. It adds entries for BIP 433 (Pay to Anchor) and BIP 461 (Deterministic ECDSA signatures with low-R grinding) to doc/bips.md.
